local ExecuteBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
ExecuteBtn.Parent = ExecutorFrame
ExecuteBtn.Text = "Execute"
ExecuteBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 120, 200)
ExecuteBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

local ClearBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")

ClearBtn.Text = "Clear"
ClearBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 55, 70)
ClearBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
ClearBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 0, 30)
ClearBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.55, 0, 0.78, 0)
ClearBtn.TextSize = 16

---------------------------------------------------------
-- برمجة الأزرار والتشغيل الفعلي للـ الأكواد
---------------------------------------------------------

-- التحقق من الحساب عند الضغط على Submit
SubmitBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if UserInput.Text == "ppp" and PassInput.Text == "ttt" then
        SubmitBtn.Text = "Success!"
        task.wait(0.3)
        LoginFrame.Visible = false
        ExecutorFrame.Visible = true
    else
        SubmitBtn.Text = "Wrong Password!"
        task.wait(1)
        SubmitBtn.Text = "Submit"
    end
end)

-- تشغيل السكربت المدخل داخل صندوق النص (طريقة معالجة الأخطاء الآمنة لـ Delta)
ExecuteBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local code = ScriptBox.Text
    if code and code ~= "" then
        local rawFunc, parseError = loadstring(code)
        if rawFunc then
            local success, runError = pcall(rawFunc)
            if not success then
                warn("Runtime Error: " .. tostring(runError))
            end
        else
            warn("Syntax Error: " .. tostring(parseError))
        end
    end
end)

-- مسح النص
ClearBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    ScriptBox.Text = ""
end)
